prompt: 文意選填：選出最適合空格的詞性。
text: The new library is a very _____ place to study.

wrong.quietly: quietly 是副詞，無法修飾名詞 place。
wrong.quietness: quietness 是名詞，前面已有 very，需要形容詞。

why: very 和名詞 place 之間需要形容詞，quiet 是形容詞。
tip: 空格在名詞前，通常要填形容詞。
say: The new library is a very quiet place to study.

text: The experiment failed. _____, the team learned something useful from it.

wrong.Therefore: Therefore 表示結果，但失敗不是學到東西的原因。
wrong.Similarly: Similarly 表示相似，後句卻是正面的轉折。

why: 實驗失敗但仍有收穫，是轉折，Even so 表示儘管如此。
say: The experiment failed. Even so, the team learned something useful from it.

prompt: 第二句中的 it 指什麼？
text: The town built a new bridge last year. It has reduced travel time by half.

wrong.去年: last year 是時間，不能縮短旅行時間。
wrong.這個鎮: the town 是主詞，但縮短行車時間的是橋。

why: It 回指前面的 a new bridge，能減少行車時間的是橋。
tip: 代名詞通常回指離它最近的合理名詞。
say: It has reduced travel time by half.

text: Several students apologized. _____, only one admitted the real mistake.

wrong.For example: 後句沒有舉例，而是縮小範圍並轉折。
wrong.As a result: 只有一人承認不是道歉的結果。

why: 前句多人道歉，後句強調只有一人承認真正錯誤，是轉折。
tip: 前後有落差時，優先想 However。
say: Several students apologized. However, only one admitted the real mistake.

prompt: 哪一句的比較結構正確？
options: This book is as useful as that one.
This book is as more useful as that one.
This book is so useful than that one.
answer: This book is as useful as that one.

as...as 之間要放原級形容詞，不能放 more useful。
than 搭配比較級，原級比較用 as...as。

why: 同等比較 as + 原級 + as。
tip: 同等比較：as + 原級 + as。
say: This book is as useful as that one.

text: The author uses humor _____ readers stay interested.

wrong.helping: helping 後面接 readers stay 不符合結構，目的需用不定詞。
wrong.for help: for help 是名詞片語，無法接 readers stay interested。

why: to help + 受詞 + 原形，表示目的，幫助讀者保持興趣。
tip: 表示目的用 to + V，help 後可省略 to。
say: The author uses humor to help readers stay interested.

prompt: 這一段最後一句的功用是什麼？
text: Cats sleep many hours a day. Dogs, on the other hand, are more active. In short, pets differ greatly in habits.

wrong.開始講新主題: In short 是總結，並沒有開啟新主題。
wrong.反駁前面的說法: last sentence 順著前文，說明寵物習性不同，並沒有反對。

why: In short 引導總結，歸納貓與狗的差異。
tip: In short、To sum up 引導總結。
say: In short, pets differ greatly in habits.

text: A _____ example of kindness is helping a stranger carry heavy bags.

wrong.simply: simply 是副詞，不能修飾名詞 example。
wrong.simplify: simplify 是動詞，位置需要形容詞。

why: example 是名詞，前面需要形容詞 simple。
tip: 冠詞後、名詞前，填形容詞。
say: A simple example of kindness is helping a stranger carry heavy bags.

prompt: 文章前半段說某政策有好處，後半段要開始談缺點，開頭應該用？
options: On the other hand, the policy has some drawbacks.
In addition, the policy has some drawbacks.
Likewise, the policy has some drawbacks.
answer: On the other hand, the policy has some drawbacks.

wrong.In addition, the policy has some drawbac: In addition 用於補充同類資訊，優點之後談缺點是反面。
Likewise 是同樣地，優點與缺點方向相反。

why: 由優點轉到缺點，是對照關係，用 On the other hand。
tip: 優點轉缺點，用 On the other hand。
say: On the other hand, the policy has some drawbacks.

text: She was absent today; _____, she missed the quiz.

wrong.however: however 表示轉折，缺席與錯過小考是因果。
wrong.meanwhile: meanwhile 是同時間，沒有表示因果。

why: 缺席導致沒考到小考，用 therefore 表示結果。
tip: 分號後接 therefore，表示因此。
say: She was absent today; therefore, she missed the quiz.

text: The film was long; nevertheless, I enjoyed every minute.
options: 電影雖然很長，我還是全程享受
answer: 電影雖然很長，我還是全程享受

wrong.電影太長，我中途離場: nevertheless 後面是 enjoyed every minute，沒有離場。
wrong.電影很短，我不喜歡: 句子說電影 long，而且 enjoyed 是喜歡。

why: nevertheless 是儘管如此，電影長但仍喜歡。
tip: nevertheless：儘管如此，後面是反方向結果。
say: The film was long; nevertheless, I enjoyed every minute.

prompt: 哪一句的代名詞用法正確？
options: The students handed in their essays on time.
The students handed in his essays on time.
The students handed in its essays on time.
answer: The students handed in their essays on time.

wrong.The students handed in his essays on tim: the students 是複數，所有格要用 their。
wrong.The students handed in its essays on tim: its 用於事物，students 是人，且是複數。

why: 代名詞需要與先行詞的數與性一致，複數用 their。
tip: 代名詞要和指稱的名詞單複數一致。
say: The students handed in their essays on time.
